exam.title: 2027 Bar Examinations
exam.source: Supreme Court of the Philippines, Office of the 2027 Bar Chairperson, Bar Bulletin No. 1-2027, September 16, 2026 (Modality, Schedule, Coverage, and Syllabus)
exam.controllingTextNote: Per the Bulletin, where a reproduction of the Bar Bulletins or syllabus differs from the text posted on the official microsite, the posted text controls.
exam.format: Administered electronically at local testing centers. Morning 8:00 a.m. to 12:00 noon; afternoon 2:00 to 6:00 p.m.
exam.problemWeight: A single-question problem is 5%; a two-question problem has a combined weight of 5%.
exam.cutoffNote: Only laws, rules, issuances and jurisprudence promulgated as of June 30, 2026 are examinable. Only the doctrines and dispositions in the main opinion are examinable. Computations require only basic arithmetic; Criminal Law examinees are not required to compute specific periods of penalties.
